# blurhash

Vendored from [woltapp/blurhash](https://github.com/woltapp/blurhash) at commit
`0a1f97898d9eb8952bc528cd7a8ec73d9fecf5d0`.

- `Sources/blurhash/` holds upstream's `Swift/BlurHashDecode.swift` and `Swift/BlurHashEncode.swift`, unmodified.
- `License.txt` is upstream's `Swift/License.txt`, unmodified.
- `Package.swift` and `acknowledgement.json` are ours.

To update, copy those files from the new upstream commit, update the commit above, and run
`Scripts/generate_acknowledgements.py` if the license changed.
